title: [SaS] Scraps and Salvage
description: Allows armor and tools to be salvaged into scrap which can be crafted into ingots.
body:
# [SaS] Scraps and Salvage

Turn old gear into useful materials!

## Features
- Salvage **Copper** armor and tools into **Copper Scrap**
- Salvage **Gold** armor and tools into **Gold Scrap**
- Salvage **Iron** armor and tools into **Iron Scrap**
- **Durability doesn't matter** — damaged items give the same amount of scrap as fully repaired ones (perfect for mob farms!)

## Crafting
Place armor or tools into a crafting table to obtain scrap.

Combine **3 Scrap horizontally** in a crafting table to create an ingot again.

## Supported Materials
- Copper
- Iron
- Gold

More features are planned for future updates!

Happy salvaging!
